data.title: Reading and Calculating Slope from Triangles
data.description: Practice determining the slope of various linear graphs by analyzing the rise and run of pre-drawn right triangles, working with both integer and fractional values.

challenges.instruction: Use the triangle to calculate the slope of this line. Slope = rise ÷ run.
challenges.hint: Read Δy (the vertical leg) and Δx (the horizontal leg) off the triangle's labels. The slope is Δy ÷ Δx — and the sign of Δy is the sign of the slope.
